title: Add independent CUDA differential execution adapter
problem: CUDA source compilation needs compiler-specific language and architecture flags, and successful compilation alone cannot establish that a kernel executed.
example:
--route cuda selects Clang CUDA; --route nvcc selects NVIDIA nvcc.
Both launch one execute_case(index) kernel, check launch/synchronization errors,
and require FFMT_DEVICE metadata before comparing stdout bytes.
design: Keep both CUDA compiler routes in one handwritten runtime adapter. Probe device availability, record the selected device, launch one thread, and synchronize before the process exits.
tradeoffs: The common fixture stays free of fmt device code. These Python tests inspect the generated source and flags; a CUDA device/runtime is still required to establish execution.
docs: Run a literal case in a one-thread CUDA kernel through nvcc or Clang. Execution requires a CUDA device and runtime; Python checks only source generation here.
